approval.notes: Justin accepted 2026-09-19 all Prompt T draft offices: 432 current + 69 historical. Standing policy: retain offices and historic rows even outside the ~18-month alert window. Tiers 414 municipal / 12 regional / 3 national / 72 other. Keep drafted tiers on ~147 focused-review rows; Justin accepted the register universe. Hilversum/Wijdemeren merger successor binding stays open. Named historic gaps / partial coverage stay open. Appointed mayors: no mayoral election rows. No Netherlands importer, electiondatabase redirects, or Mexico changes in this landing.

schema_compatibility_note: national maps to schema v1 national_context. council is unused legacy vocabulary; no row emits it. unknown maps to NULL/unknown, never other. Focused-review rows keep drafted tiers.

importer_policy.note: No Netherlands Atlas importer in this landing. A future separately authorized importer may load all 501 accepted offices. Do not invent mayoral election rows or resolve Hilversum/Wijdemeren successor binding.

rules: Tier is derived from sourced institution and jurisdiction, never calendar cohort.
National → national_context; council remains office_type, never an unsupported geographic SQLite tier.
One office per elected body/mandate, not fabricated numbered seat or mayor rows.
Historical offices and out-of-window current offices retained.
Uncertainty does not map to other automatically; other here has explicit functional/submunicipal rationale.
Justin accepted all 501 draft offices on 2026-09-19. Focused-tier review flags and Hilversum/Wijdemeren successor binding stay open and do not un-accept sourced rows.
